Ben/Lena — quick capacity note: we can provision a dedicated pool of 2x A100 equivalents in the us‑west region. ETA from provisioning request to active is typically 5 business days if we have signed SOW + billing. If Aurelia needs faster access, we can run an interim hosted route with throttling and temporary KV caching to simulate production latency — will cost slightly more but removes lead time risk.

I updated the MAP sheet with a provisioning ETA field and added a conditional path for "Sign by May 10" vs "Sign after May 10". Also added the rollback sequence steps into the cutover checklist (included below).

Rollback sequence (summary):
1) Pause traffic to Redwood Dedicated pool (route to hosted fallback)
2) Invalidate prefix/KV cache for session tokens less than 8 hours
3) DNS swap to prior inference endpoint (30m TTL assumed)
4) Monitor 15m for success, then re‑open traffic; if failed re‑run provisioning request and escalate to SRE on PagerDuty

I'll attach the cutover checklist doc as well. Marissa — I'm available for the prep workshop May 11 11:00–11:30 PT.
